children: The Ritz-Carlton, Pune, part of Ventive Hospitality’s luxury hospitality portfolio, has been awarded One MICHELIN Key in the MICHELIN Guide 2026 Hotel Selection, announced on September 18, 2026. The recognition acknowledges the hotel’s service, hospitality and guest experience.

The hotel was included in the MICHELIN Guide’s curated hotel selection in July 2026, followed by its recognition within the Guide’s global hotel ecosystem. The One MICHELIN Key reflects the property’s character, attentive service, thoughtful design and attention to detail, with its Ladies and Gentlemen delivering the brand’s Gold Standards across the guest experience.
Ishwinder Gill, General Manager, The Ritz-Carlton, Pune, said:

“Receiving One MICHELIN Key is an incredibly proud moment for all of us at The Ritz-Carlton, Pune. The credit for this recognition truly belongs to our Ladies and Gentlemen, whose passion, dedication and commitment to excellence shape the guest experience every day.

What makes this recognition particularly special is the journey behind it, our constant pursuit of excellence, our willingness to evolve and, most importantly, the spirit of our people. At the heart of The Ritz-Carlton, Pune is a culture of empowerment, pride and genuine hospitality, where our Ladies and Gentlemen are encouraged to take ownership, anticipate our guests’ needs and create meaningful moments. It is this culture, lived consistently across every touchpoint, that transforms service into an experience and a stay into a lasting memory.”
Ranjit Batra, Chief Executive Officer, Ventive Hospitality, said:

“A MICHELIN Key is a significant recognition for The Ritz-Carlton, Pune and a proud milestone for Ventive Hospitality. It reflects the strength of the hotel, the commitment of our teams and partners, and the consistency with which exceptional hospitality is delivered. This recognition reinforces our focus on building distinctive hospitality assets that create enduring value and memorable guest experiences.”
